Privacy

Privacy notice

Last updated 5 November 2026

This notice explains how Siddhi Vinayak Industries (“SVI Control Panel”, “we”) handles the details you send through svicontrolpanel.com.

What we collect

When you send an enquiry through the form we receive your name, email address, phone number, company (if you give it), the panel type you select (if any), your message, and the time you agreed to this notice. We do not ask for, and you should not send, sensitive personal information.

Why we use it

Only to reply to your enquiry and to discuss, quote for and supply what you asked about. We do not sell your details or add you to marketing lists.

Where it is kept

  • The website is hosted by Vercel, and enquiries are stored in a secured cloud database operated by Supabase that only SVI can access.
  • A security check from Cloudflare Turnstile confirms that a person, not an automated program, is sending the form. Cloudflare processes technical information such as your IP address and browser details for this purpose.
  • A copy of your enquiry may be emailed to our team so we can respond quickly.
  • If you choose to send your message by WhatsApp or email instead, it is handled by WhatsApp or your email provider under their own terms.
  • The map in our contact section is shown by Google Maps. When it loads, Google receives your IP address and may set cookies under its own terms.

This website itself does not use advertising or analytics cookies.

How long we keep it

We keep enquiry details only for as long as we need them to respond and for related business records, and then delete them.

Your choices

You can ask us to show, correct or delete the details you sent by emailing ghanshyam_me2@yahoo.com or calling +91 98251 08477.

Contact
